ClientRef.description:
The client project and revision a submission comes from.

Attributes:
    project: Plain project name, lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
    git_sha: Commit of the client repository the strategy code was taken from (7 to 40 hex
        characters).
    hypothesis_id: The client's identifier of the hypothesis under test.

project.description: Client project name: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens.
project.title: Project

ClientRef.title: ClientRef

DateWindow.description:
A closed date range, `start <= end`.

Attributes:
    start: First day.
    end: Last day, inclusive.
DateWindow.title: DateWindow

DecisionFileSpec.description:
The replay decision file: one Parquet per variant, read as rows of `DecisionRow`.

A full snapshot of target weights per decision date; an instrument absent from a date's rows
has weight 0. Decided after the close of `decision_date`, filled at the open of the next
session. A file holds one asset class: equity (bond ETFs included) or FX.

Attributes:
    path: The Parquet file, relative to the submission folder.
    sources: The input sources the rows' `source` column may name, each listed once.
DecisionFileSpec.title: DecisionFileSpec

DecisionSource.description:
One input source of a decision file, declared once for the look-ahead audit.

A dated source says whether it can publish after the close (earnings releases, 8-Ks, Form 4
filings, FINRA short interest). An undated source has no publication date at all (a current
SIC code used to screen candidates); it states its `limitation` and is never named by a row.

Attributes:
    name: The name rows use in their `source` column.
    can_publish_after_close: `True` when the source can publish after the 16:00 ET close of a
        session, `False` when it always publishes before it; absent for an undated source.
    undated: `True` for a source with no date; it then needs a `limitation`.
    limitation: One line saying what an undated source is and where it is used.
DecisionSource.title: DecisionSource

LakeQuery.description:
One query against a lake table.

Attributes:
    table: The lake table.
    sql: The query text.
LakeQuery.title: LakeQuery

LakeQueryBundle.description:
Data to be read from the lake as of a fixed time.

Attributes:
    kind: `"lake"`.
    lake_time: The lake state to read, a UTC timestamp.
    queries: The queries; may be empty.
LakeQueryBundle.title: LakeQueryBundle

ParquetBundle.description:
Data supplied as a Parquet bundle inside the submission folder.

Attributes:
    kind: `"parquet"`.
    path: The bundle folder, relative to the submission folder.
ParquetBundle.title: ParquetBundle

PriorExposure.description:
Earlier looks of this strategy family at the data, which the trial count did not see.

Attributes:
    note: What the earlier looks were.
    windows: The date windows the earlier runs of this family (its variants) were evaluated on.
    min_count: The known lower bound of those uncounted earlier runs.
PriorExposure.title: PriorExposure

ScoreWindow.description:
The window the evidence is scored on, `start < end`.

Attributes:
    start: First day.
    end: Last day, strictly after `start`.
ScoreWindow.title: ScoreWindow

TrialDeclaration.description:
How many hypotheses the client tried before this one, as the client states it.

Attributes:
    family_id: The client's name for the trial family.
    declared_n: Number of trials the client counts for the family.
    ledger_ref: The client's ledger reference, or `None`.
    test_keys: The client's keys of the tests behind `declared_n` (unique); `None` when not
        given. At most `declared_n` of them.
    ledger_export_path: Path inside the folder to the client's ledger export, or `None`.
    prior_exposure: Earlier looks at the data that are not in the count, or `None`.
TrialDeclaration.title: TrialDeclaration

UpgradedFrom.description:
What `edgelab submission upgrade` records about the folder it made a version 2 one from.

Attributes:
    src_manifest_sha256: Hash of the source folder's content-set manifest.
    src_manifest_files: Number of files in the source folder's content set.
    dropped_grading_sha256: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the `grading:` block the upgrade
        removed from `strategy.yaml`; `None` when it removed nothing.
    dest_manifest_sha256: Hash of the new folder's own content-set manifest; it differs from
        the source's when a block was dropped.
    dest_manifest_files: Number of files in the new folder's content set.
UpgradedFrom.title: UpgradedFrom

description:
The content of a submission folder's `submission.json`.

Attributes:
    schema_version: `1` or `2`. Version 2 adds `policy` and `upgraded_from`; every other field
        is the same.
    kind: `"code"` (a strategy the pipeline runs) or `"replay"` (a decision file replayed by a
        `TargetWeightsReplay` strategy).
    client: Which client project and commit this comes from.
    strategy_dir: The strategy folder, relative to the submission folder; holds
        `strategy.yaml` for a `code` submission.
    data: Where the data comes from: a Parquet bundle in the folder, or a lake query bundle
        (validated but not run yet).
    decisions: The decision file; required for `replay`, absent for `code`.
    trials: The client's trial declaration.
    groups_path: Parquet file with columns `instrument_id` and `group`, or `None`.
    train_end: The last date the client used to design or fit the strategy; data up to it is
        warm-up and features only. `None` when not stated.
    test_window: The window the evidence is scored on, starting after `train_end`; `None`
        scores the strategy config's data range.
    seed: Seed of every stochastic step of the run.
    profile: Sample-size profile of the run.
    policy: A published grading policy name, version 2 only. The run is graded under that
        policy's registered values and records the policy and its cost table hash. The
        strategy folder's `grading:` block is then optional and, when present, must equal
        them. `None` grades under the folder's block, which is then required.
    upgraded_from: Set by `submission upgrade`, version 2 only: the manifests of the source
        and of this folder and the hash of the dropped `grading:` block.
title: Submission
